*Updated 2026-09-29 · 107 works indexed · regenerated after each daily run.*

One hundred and seven works. The September 29 microphone piece scores 2, closing the last twelve at 2, 2, 1, 2, 2, 1, 2, 3, 2, 2, 2, 2 — median still 2, the hurricane barometer's 3 still the only outlier in the window, and the ceiling has not moved since the rebar and mop-smear pieces scored 4 in late July. That is now two full months without a score above 3.

Camera position remains the most measurable constraint. Straight-on accounts for 27 of 107 all-time, overhead 10, from-behind 10, low-angle 4. The last twelve show no overhead, no low-angle, no through-frame — every work in that window is frontal or unspecified. Every score of 4 in the archive arrived through a displaced axis: the overhead mop smear, the overhead tarp cartography, the from-below rebar. The barometer reached 3 through perceptual estrangement inside a frontal frame and that remains the closest a straight-on composition has come to the ceiling. Two months of frontal work have not broken that pattern. The camera has to move before the scores can.

Scale violation sits at 30 of 107 all-time but only 5 of the last 12, and two of those — the seedling and the water jug — had scale built into the conceit from the start rather than discovered under pressure from the anchor. Genuine surprise violation, where no other answer fit the specific story, has been rare for weeks. Figures continue their retreat: the last twelve show none or one per frame without exception, and focal-object discipline holds — courgette, stump, tin can, fallen cylinder, microphone grille — no repetition inside the window.

Register compression is unchanged: aftermath and menace together account for 43 of 107. Foreboding appeared twice in the recent window, encroachment once. Betrayed defiance, reprieve, reckoning, and exhaustion have each appeared once across the full archive and have not returned — any of them could carry new work if the anchor genuinely requires it, but forcing a dormant register onto an anchor that doesn't need it produces nothing. Title grammar continues to scatter: six of the last twelve are miscellaneous constructions.

The work is consistent and controlled at its floor. Consistency at the floor is not the same as pressure on the ceiling. Move the camera; the scores follow.
